name: essay perfect
question: Explain why a recursive function needs a base case.

rubric.point: recursion means the function calls itself
the base case stops the recursion
without it the calls never end and the stack overflows

model_answer: A recursive function calls itself, so it needs a base case that stops the calls. Without one it keeps calling itself until the stack memory runs out, a stack overflow.
source: Every recursive function needs a base case that stops the recursion
answer: Recursion is when a function calls itself again and again. The base case is the condition where it stops calling itself and returns. If there is no base case the calls never end, so the program runs out of stack memory and crashes with a stack overflow.
